OpenVector uses the Independent JPEG Group's jpeg-6b compressor.
This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The selected C sources and headers are unmodified copies of the IJG component
distributed with Qt 4.4.3. Their copyright and license terms are retained in
README. No ansi2knr source is included.

The Rust engine calls the native wrapper in
rust/crates/openvector/csrc/bitmap_jpeg.c. The crate's build.rs compiles that
wrapper and these IJG sources into the engine. The wrapper provides a growing
memory destination, host allocation, setjmp/longjmp error recovery and
top-down BGRA-to-RGB scanlines. It replaces the JavaScript reference wrapper's
per-call WebAssembly arena and trap-based error reporting. The build uses
NO_GETENV to avoid host environment access. Upstream codec files are unchanged.
Default compression is quality 75, baseline JPEG, RGB input and 96-DPI density.

The Rust caller, native wrapper and build script are OpenVector application
code. This component is compiled into the native CLI, Node-API library and
GPUI application. It requires no Vector Magic or Qt installation.
